name: RegTech Compliance Protocol
description: PEP 顧客タイプの match 漏れを Z3 が検出し、全顧客タイプの網羅性と取引限度額遵守を2層で検証するデモ

intro: Step 1: LLM generates KYC/AML compliance code...
Step 2: mumei verify checks match exhaustiveness...
narrative.before: LLM が KYC/AML コンプライアンスコードを生成（バグ入り: match 網羅性不足）
narrative.after: mumei verify → match 網羅性違反でバグ検出し、正しい実装を Z3 で証明

rejected.headline: BUG DETECTED! Match exhaustiveness violation
follow_up: mumei verify rejects the buggy KYC/AML classifier.

pass.headline: All atoms verified
follow_up: every transaction stays within its risk-based limit.

steps.name: Z3 Bug Detection: buggy_classify_risk
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the expected rejection diagnostic.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 1 and emits expected rejection evidence (Match is not exhaustive, Counter-example, CustomerType::PEP (tag=3)).

steps.name: Z3 Negative Test Suite: missing PEP arm
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the expected rejection diagnostic.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 1 and emits expected rejection evidence (Match is not exhaustive, Counter-example, CustomerType::PEP (tag=3)).

steps.name: Z3 Correct Compliance Verification
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (Verification passed, verified, demo_verify_all_transactions_compliant).

steps.name: Z3 E2E Test Suite
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the verifier gate evidence.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (Verification passed).

steps.name: Agent Forge Dry Run
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the agent gate evidence.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (vstd-regtech).

harness_contract.intent: Prove KYC/AML risk classification is exhaustive and transaction limits hold for all customer types.
artifact_contracts: Generate evidence: result.json and report.md in reports/{scenario}/latest/ plus per-step logs.
result.json records missing-PEP rejection, negative-suite rejection, correct Z3 acceptance, E2E verification, and agent dry-run.
compliance.proof.json is the L1 Z3 proof certificate for the corrected compliance atoms.
dashboard/summary.md aggregates PASS and proof-density evidence for the scenario.
Gate order: l1_z3 -> l2_agent; each stage must satisfy its expected_exit, expected_patterns, artifacts, and depends_on contract before downstream evidence is trusted.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: RegTech compliance must cover PEP customers and enforce risk-based transaction limits.
success_criteria: buggy classifier and negative suite are rejected with the PEP counterexample.
intent_fidelity.drift_risk: Low: expected diagnostics name the omitted CustomerType::PEP case.
